The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''36,019 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]''', also known as the year '''434 after the [[Tho Yor Arrival]]''', was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[pre-Republic era]]. By that year, the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] had established [[Padawan Kesh]], one of their [[Je'daii Temples]], and [[Nordia Gral]] was serving as Padawan Kesh's first [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
